\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n"]; let currentFocus = 1; function setMode(mode) { const grid = document.getElementById('gridView'); const focus = document.getElementById('focusView'); const btnGrid = document.getElementById('btnGrid'); const btnNew = document.getElementById('btnNewOnly'); const btnStory = document.getElementById('btnStoryOnly'); const btnFocus = document.getElementById('btnFocus'); btnGrid.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'grid'); btnNew.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'new'); btnStory.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'story'); btnFocus.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'focus'); if (mode === 'focus') { grid.classList.add('hidden'); focus.classList.add('active'); } else { grid.classList.remove('hidden'); focus.classList.remove('active'); document.querySelectorAll('.screen-card').forEach((card) => { const isStory = card.getAttribute('data-category') === 'story'; const isNew = card.getAttribute('data-new') === 'true'; if (mode === 'new') { card.classList.toggle('filtered-out', !isNew); } else if (mode === 'story') { card.classList.toggle('filtered-out', !isStory); } else { card.classList.remove('filtered-out'); } }); } } function openFocus(idx) { currentFocus = idx; setMode('focus'); const iframe = document.getElementById('focusIframe'); iframe.srcdoc = SCREEN_DOCS[idx]; document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach((btn, i) => { btn.classList.toggle('active', i === idx); }); }
